compiler_environment: Frozen archive reuses installed dependencies through a symlink; tsc uses --preserveSymlinks with all project strict checks intact. Build executes tsc followed by the unchanged copy-assets.mjs.
setup_observations: Default symlink realpath resolution caused TS2742 in pre-existing McpServer inference. A bulk dependency copy was stopped because small-file copying was too slow; final run uses explicit TypeScript symlink preservation. Failed setup artifacts remain managed.
